country: Nordic countries (Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Iceland, Greenland, Faroe Islands)

links.outcome: Proportion of radiographers who received AI training in clinical practice
links.effect: 43% (n = 254) had not received any AI training in clinical practice; 13% (n = 76) received AI content in undergraduate training; 77.9% (n = 412) interested in AI education.
links.quote: A total of 43% (n = 254) of the respondents had not received any AI training in clinical practice.

links.outcome: Radiographers' AI awareness versus AI educational level
links.effect: AI awareness high (82.8% aware of potential use) but educational level low; 77.9% interested in pursuing AI education.
links.quote: In general, awareness of AI applications is high, but the educational level is low for Nordic radiographers.

screen.reason: A cross-sectional survey examining radiographers' and radiography students' perspectives, readiness, and attitudes toward AI implementation in radiology.
